ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio; approximately 90% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels, bounded by a 10% low-intensity (black) perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous light-gray central field. Solid black high-contrast banding is present along the entire trailing edge. Two distinct localized dark blobs are visible: a small circular focal spot in the mid-lateral region of the left lobe and a larger, vertically-oriented elliptical spot in the mid-lateral region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged topography and upward-projecting peaks are observed at the distal fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curve sweeping from the central notch toward the hooked distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward 'hooking' or recurved orientation of both distal fluke tips, with the right tip exhibiting a more complex, multi-peaked edge profile.
